name: QTS Data Centers

source.quote: will acquire all outstanding shares of common stock of QTS Realty Trust for $78.00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $10 billion

description: Hyperscale data center developer and operator owned by Blackstone since 2021.
explain: QTS builds giant data center campuses leased to cloud and AI companies. Blackstone bought it for about $10 billion (including debt) in 2021 and has poured billions more into expansion.
